bounded_host_request.command:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import shutil,pathlib,sys,subprocess
ok=True
for name in ("ffmpeg","ffprobe"):
 path=shutil.which(name)
 if not path:ok=False
 else:
  r=subprocess.run([path,"-version"],capture_output=True,timeout=10)
  if r.returncode:ok=False
home=pathlib.Path.home()
space=shutil.disk_usage(home).free
if space<1024*1024*1024:ok=False
print("ACTION=MEDIA_RUNTIME_PREREQUISITES")
print("EXECUTABLES="+("PASS" if all(shutil.which(x) for x in ("ffmpeg","ffprobe")) else "MISSING"))
print("DISK_THRESHOLD="+("PASS" if space>=1024*1024*1024 else "LOW"))
print("VERIFY="+("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 44)
PY
